nodes.label: ADR 0025: Activation Funnel Milestone Definitions
nodes.rationale: Seven milestones in logical operational sequence: (1) email_verified, (2) hierarchy_seeded, (3) first_member, (4) first_customer, (5) ghl_connected, (6) first_appointment, (7) first_payment. Each milestone's reachedAt = MIN(created_at) of qualifying row. stuckAt = first unreached milestone. No new persistence — derived from existing tables at read time. Five parallel tenant-DB count queries per drill-in.
alternatives_rejected: Event-sourced milestones / tenant_events log (new persistence coupled to every business write)
Compute funnel during daily usage snapshot (doubles cron work, column-bloat risk)
5 or 9 milestones (7 is the natural onboarding sequence)

nodes.label: Activation Funnel (7 milestones, derived from existing tables)
